brief.headline: B-52 To Get Stealthy AGM-158C Long-Range Anti-Ship Missiles
brief.summary: 本期从 49 个公开信源筛选出 10 条重点事件，覆盖科技、AI、航空航天、安全动态与无人系统。
signals: 军事动态：The U.S. Navy is preparing to sign a contract with Lockheed Martin to integrate the stealthy AGM-158C Long Range Anti-Ship Missile (LRASM) onto the Air Force’s B-52 Stratofortress bombers, according to an October 7 government notice. The effort would add another long-range maritime strike option to the U.S. bomber force as the military looks to counter increasingly capable adversary naval forces, especially in the Indo-Pacific theater. U.S. Willis The latest Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) notice says the command intends to enter into sole-source negotiations with Lockheed Martin and subsequently award a cost-plus-fixed-fee delivery order covering LRASM integration on the B-52. The B-52 can carry up to 20 JASSMs, and the weapons have the same dimensions, but the government notice does not specify how many LRASMs the bomber would ultimately carry. A B-52 flies across the Atlantic Ocean on June 17, 2019, for a flight in support of Exercise BALTOPS 2019, the largest multinational maritime exercise of the year in the Baltic Sea. The U.S. Air Force’s Fiscal Year 2027 budget proposal further outlines plans to integrate the latest variants of LRASM and JASSM onto the B-52, including versions not yet cleared for use on the bomber. Planned work in FY2027 includes incorporating the missiles’ operational flight programs into the B-52’s baseline bomber software, validating safe weapon separation from both wing-mounted stations and the internal carriage launcher, updating armament interfaces, and completing system-safety testing.

航空航天：The South Korean government has released images from its first successful test of a domestically developed hypersonic boost-glide vehicle. This includes shots of the vehicle impacting the water at the end of its flight. A weapon of this kind would give South Korea a significant new way to hold targets in North Korea at risk amid an ever-deepening arms race on the Peninsula . A trio of pictures showing South Korea’s new hypersonic boost-glide vehicle impacting the water during the test yesterday. The Blue House Another view of the impact at the end of yesterday’s South Korea hypersonic test as seen through what looks to be an electro-optical video camera on an aircraft. The Blue House As mentioned, there are also pictures of the hypersonic boost-glide vehicle hitting the water. Another close-up look at the hypersonic boost-glide vehicle test yesterday, showing what looks to be a truncated fin on one side. “The HGV [hypersonic boost-glide vehicle] successfully separated after ascending to the target altitude and executed its planned flight path within the hypersonic environment without any issues.” With all this in mind, the fact that the vehicle just remained intact through to impact is noteworthy. At the time of writing, South Korean authorities do not appear to have disclosed more specific details about the test, including how far the boost-glide vehicle traveled before hitting the water or what peak speed it reached.

局部冲突：The co-pilot who tried to seize control of a passenger jet flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv last week was planning to launch a suicide attack targeting the passenger terminal at Israel’s international airport, prosecutors in the United Arab Emirates said on Friday. Passengers then tried to control the aircraft, which was safely landed in Saudi Arabia by an off-duty relief pilot who was among about 180 passengers. Dr Hamad Saif al-Shamsi, attorney-general of the UAE, said on Friday that al-Hammami, who is in Emirate custody, had admitted he had tried to execute a “premeditated terrorist plot to … launch a suicide attack targeting the passenger terminal at Ben Gurion airport near Tel Aviv, with the aim of causing the greatest possible loss of life”. The 29-year-old, who was hired by flydubai, a government-owned low-cost airline, began a process of radicalisation while studying in Australia when he was influenced by the hardline takfiri ideology through reading extremist literature and online content glorifying terrorist organisations and suicide attacks, al-Shamsi said in a statement.

displayTranslation.title: B-52将获得隐身AGM-158C远程反舰导弹
displayTranslation.summary: 据10月7日发布的一份政府通告，美国海军正准备与洛克希德·马丁公司签署合同，将隐身AGM-158C远程反舰导弹（LRASM）整合到美国空军的B-52“同温层堡垒”轰炸机上。最新发布的海军航空系统司令部（NAVAIR）通告称，该司令部打算与洛克希德·马丁公司进行单一来源谈判，随后授予一份成本加固定费用交付订单，内容涵盖LRASM在B-52上的整合工作。文章称，此举将为美国轰炸机部队增加另一种远程海上打击选项，因为美军正寻求应对能力日益增强的对手海军力量，尤其是在印太战区。B-52最多可携带20枚JASSM，两种武器尺寸相同，但政府通告未说明该轰炸机最终将携带多少枚LRASM。美国空军2027财年预算提案进一步提出，计划将最新型号的LRASM和JASSM整合到B-52上，其中包括尚未获准在该轰炸机上使用的型号。2027财年的计划工作包括：将导弹的作战飞行程序纳入B-52基线轰炸机软件、验证从翼下挂架和内部挂载发射器投弹的安全分离、更新武器接口，以及完成系统安全测试。对B-52而言，加入LRASM将使其在既有的对地攻击武器库之外，获得一种专用的反舰武器。B-52还通过“快击”系列航空水雷展示了布设水雷的能力。

At the time of writing, South Korean authorities do not appear to have disclosed more specific details about the test, including how far the boost-glide vehicle traveled before hitting the water or what peak speed it reached.

displayTranslation.title: 韩国首次公开刚刚试射的高超音速助推滑翔飞行器
displayTranslation.summary: 韩国政府公布了其首次成功试射国产高超音速助推滑翔飞行器的图像，其中包括飞行器在飞行末段撞入水中的画面。文章称，在半岛军备竞赛日益加剧的背景下，这类武器将为韩国提供一种重要的新手段，使其能够威胁朝鲜境内的目标。公布的一组三张照片显示，韩国新型高超音速助推滑翔飞行器在昨天的试射中撞入水中。青瓦台还提供了从飞机上的光电摄像机拍摄的另一种视角，展示昨天韩国高超音速试射末段撞击水面的情形。此外还有飞行器撞入水中的照片，以及一张特写，显示飞行器一侧似乎有一个截断的尾翼。根据引述，飞行器“在爬升至目标高度后成功分离，并在高超音速环境下按计划飞行路径飞行，未出现任何问题”。文章指出，该飞行器一直保持完整直至撞击，这一点值得注意。截至文章撰写时，韩国当局似乎尚未披露有关此次试射的更多具体细节，包括飞行器在撞入水中之前飞行了多远，或达到了怎样的峰值速度。青瓦台发布的材料明确称，该高超音速助推滑翔飞行器是“能够改变战场游戏规则的关键战略资产”，其不可预测的飞行弹道和压倒性速度使其能够在紧急情况下对关键战略目标发动突袭。文章还提到，韩国拥有一整套国产地面发射弹道导弹，可作为发射无动力高超音速助推滑翔飞行器的合适起点。

displayTranslation.title: 阿联酋检方称迪拜航空副驾驶策划对以色列机场发动自杀式袭击
displayTranslation.summary: 阿联酋检方周五表示，上周试图夺取一架从迪拜飞往特拉维夫客机控制权的副驾驶，策划对以色列国际机场的客运航站楼发动自杀式袭击。涉事人员名为哈马姆·哈马米（Hammam al-Hammami）。阿联酋总检察长哈马德·赛义夫·沙姆西博士周五称，目前被阿联酋羁押的哈马米已承认，他试图执行一项“有预谋的恐怖阴谋……对特拉维夫附近本·古里安机场的客运航站楼发动自杀式袭击，目的是造成尽可能多的人员伤亡”。沙姆西在声明中表示，这名29岁的男子受雇于政府所有的低成本航空公司迪拜航空，他在澳大利亚留学期间开始激进化进程，通过阅读极端主义文献以及美化恐怖组织和自杀式袭击的网络内容，受到强硬派“塔克菲里”意识形态的影响。沙姆西称，哈马米曾用应急斧袭击该航班的印度籍机长，但未能阻止这位伤势严重的机长打开驾驶舱安全门，让乘客得以制服袭击者。随后乘客试图控制飞机，这架飞机由乘客中一名休班替补飞行员安全降落在沙特阿拉伯，机上约有180名乘客。

displayTranslation.sourceSummary: The co-pilot who tried to seize control of a passenger jet flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv last week was planning to launch a suicide attack targeting the passenger terminal at Israel’s international airport, prosecutors in the United Arab Emirates said on Friday. Passengers then tried to control the aircraft, which was safely landed in Saudi Arabia by an off-duty relief pilot who was among about 180 passengers. Dr Hamad Saif al-Shamsi, attorney-general of the UAE, said on Friday that al-Hammami, who is in Emirate custody, had admitted he had tried to execute a “premeditated terrorist plot to … launch a suicide attack targeting the passenger terminal at Ben Gurion airport near Tel Aviv, with the aim of causing the greatest possible loss of life”. The 29-year-old, who was hired by flydubai, a government-owned low-cost airline, began a process of radicalisation while studying in Australia when he was influenced by the hardline takfiri ideology through reading extremist literature and online content glorifying terrorist organisations and suicide attacks, al-Shamsi said in a statement.

items.title: Guest Post: Quantum Computing’s Transistor Moment
items.originalTitle: Guest Post: Quantum Computing’s Transistor Moment
items.summary: The first is a transistor moment. In 2020, researchers in Leipzig, Germany, demonstrated the first working one-qubit diamond-based quantum computer – proof that the device physics worked outside a research setting. In 2023, fabrication of NV centers was demonstrated at production scale under Germany’s national quantum computing initiative – the “transistor” manufactured repeatably rather than hand-assembled one defect at a time. That figure deserves attention because almost no competing spin-defect platform has published a fabrication yield at all, and yield is the industrial question – how reliably usable qubits can be placed where they are wanted, at scale. Diamond – The Silicon of Quantum Computing? Whether NV-center diamond is quantum computing’s silicon – the material system that wins the platform war – is an open question. Silicon-vacancy and tin-vacancy centers in diamond have so far worked only at cryogenic temperatures, and other spin centers could eventually prove better.

displayTranslation.title: 客座文章：量子计算的“晶体管时刻”
displayTranslation.summary: 文章将量子计算当前的发展阶段类比为“晶体管时刻”。2020年，德国莱比锡的研究人员展示了首台可运行的单量子比特金刚石量子计算机，证明该器件物理机制在研究环境之外也能工作。2023年，在德国国家量子计算倡议下，氮空位（NV）中心的制造在生产规模上得到验证——即“晶体管”可以重复制造，而不是一次手工组装一个缺陷。文章认为这个数字值得关注，因为几乎没有任何竞争的自旋缺陷平台公布过制造良率，而良率正是产业化的问题所在：如何可靠地将可用的量子比特按需放置到指定位置，并实现规模化。文章提出问题：金刚石是否会成为量子计算的“硅”，即赢得平台之争的材料体系，目前仍是一个开放问题。文章指出，金刚石中的硅空位中心和锡空位中心迄今只能在低温下工作，其他自旋中心最终可能被证明更优。

items.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
items.originalTitle: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
items.summary: Three Saudi Arabian nationals have been killed in two attacks on the international airport in the capital, Riyadh, the country's civil aviation authority has said, after Yemen's Houthis said they had targeted the facility. The attacks also resulted in "injuries to a number of Saudi citizens and residents of various nationalities", the General Authority of Civil Aviation said in a statement on X. It added that the first attack on Thursday targeted the airport while the second had struck an aircraft belonging to state carrier Saudia. One of its pilots was among those killed, the airline said in a statement. Air traffic had returned to normal, the civil aviation authority said. Yemen's Houthi group said on Thursday it had attacked the airport with two ballistic missiles. The Iran-aligned group said it had also targeted an airport in Najran city near the Saudi border with Yemen, and Khamis Mushait air base further north. Saudi Arabia has not confirmed these attacks. The latest casualties follow the deaths of three people in Houthi attacks on two Saudi airports on 6 and 7 October. Two were killed and 28 wounded in an attack at Abha International Airport, the civil aviation body said on Wednesday. Another person was killed at King Khalid airport in Riyadh. The latest attacks come amid a marked escalation in renewed fighting between Yemen's Saudi-backed government forces and the Houthis, who control most of the country's north-west.

items.title: NASA Seeks US Industry Plans for Commercial Space Stations
items.originalTitle: NASA Seeks US Industry Plans for Commercial Space Stations
items.summary: Credit: NASA NASA is advancing American leadership in space by taking the next step toward a future where commercial space stations lead the way in low Earth orbit. On Friday, the agency released its final Request for Proposals inviting industry to submit plans for the next generation of commercial space stations. “In alignment with the President’s National Space Policy, NASA is committed to maintaining a sustained American presence in low Earth orbit long after the International Space Station retires,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman.

evidenceRecords.text: Credit: NASA NASA is advancing American leadership in space by taking the next step toward a future where commercial space stations lead the way in low Earth orbit.
On Friday, the agency released its final Request for Proposals inviting industry to submit plans for the next generation of commercial space stations.

“In alignment with the President’s National Space Policy, NASA is committed to maintaining a sustained American presence in low Earth orbit long after the International Space Station retires,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman.

Commercial space stations may provide that capability while creating new opportunities for American industry and allowing NASA to concentrate more of our resources on the near-impossible missions ahead.” Building on the agency’s Ignition event earlier this year, NASA regularly has engaged with private industry to shape the agency’s future direction in low Earth orbit.
This included publishing two Requests for Information in March to gather industry’s perspective on low Earth orbit destinations and transportation.

The agency also published a draft Request for Proposals in July, followed by an industry day and one-on-one meetings that allowed interested companies to review and comment on the planned acquisition approach.
“We’ve made it clear that NASA will never give up its presence in low Earth orbit,” said Isaacman.
“Since Ignition, we have spent a lot of time listening to industry and working through what it will take to make this transition successful.

We want to see credible plans, strong technical execution, and companies prepared to invest in destinations that can serve NASA while developing additional customers and markets of their own.” Proposals are due Tuesday, Dec. 8, with contract awards expected in spring 2027.

displayTranslation.summary: NASA正推进美国在太空领域的领导地位，向商业空间站主导低地球轨道的未来迈出下一步。周五，该机构发布最终方案征询书，邀请业界提交下一代商业空间站计划。NASA局长贾里德·艾萨克曼表示：“根据总统的《国家太空政策》，NASA致力于在国际空间站退役后长期维持美国在低地球轨道的持续存在。”
displayTranslation.sourceTitle: NASA Seeks US Industry Plans for Commercial Space Stations
displayTranslation.sourceSummary: Credit: NASA NASA is advancing American leadership in space by taking the next step toward a future where commercial space stations lead the way in low Earth orbit. On Friday, the agency released its final Request for Proposals inviting industry to submit plans for the next generation of commercial space stations. “In alignment with the President’s National Space Policy, NASA is committed to maintaining a sustained American presence in low Earth orbit long after the International Space Station retires,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman.

items.title: EOS lands nationwide C-UAS contract with Gulf state
items.originalTitle: EOS lands nationwide C-UAS contract with Gulf state
items.summary: Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited (EOS) has entered into an agreement with the government of a Middle Eastern Gulf state (a Gulf Co-operation Council member) for the provision of a nationwide, counter-uncrewed aerial system (C-UAS) defence system valued at GBP 370 million. EOS said on 9 October that this is the largest contract the company has secured. The company’s NiDAR C-UAS system, acquired as part of the recent MARSS acquisition, is central to the contract. It is an AI-enabled command and control system (C2), designed specifically for C-UAS defence, covering both airborne and coastal seaborne drone detection. The contract requires the rapid deployment of a cellular, nationwide C-UAS system with NiDAR C2. EOS is acting as the prime contractor and systems integrator.

items.title: NASA Demonstrates Next-Generation Heat Shield Technologies
items.originalTitle: NASA Demonstrates Next-Generation Heat Shield Technologies
items.summary: The capsules will carry a variety of thermal protective components, including proven technology such as the ceramic tile material used on the space shuttle. Others will test new options, such as a 3D-printed heat shield from the Additive Manufacturing of Thermal Protective Systems project developed at NASA Johnson and Oak Ridge National Laboratory. Researchers at NASA Ames are contributing several materials to KREPE-3, including two capsules that will fly a next-generation family of protective coverings known as Materials Engineered for Re-entry using Innovative Needling Operations (MERINO).

evidenceRecords.text: Inside the capsule is a 3-D printed heat shield designed by researchers at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston.
NASA NASA is testing heat shields that can keep astronauts safe as they return from missions to the Moon and Mars in an unusual way: by taking out the trash.

When Northrop Grumman 24 th cargo resupply mission for NASA undocked from the International Space Station, it carried a fleet of 12 small, experimental capsules designed to test the next generation of thermal protection materials that could serve as the foundation for future heat shields.
Others will test new options, such as a 3D-printed heat shield from the Additive Manufacturing of Thermal Protective Systems project developed at NASA Johnson and Oak Ridge National Laboratory.
The capsules will carry a variety of thermal protective components, including proven technology such as the ceramic tile material used on the space shuttle.

Researchers at NASA Ames are contributing several materials to KREPE-3, including two capsules that will fly a next-generation family of protective coverings known as Materials Engineered for Re-entry using Innovative Needling Operations (MERINO).
